headlines.headline: UK selects Tekever AR5 surveillance drones to replace Watchkeeper fleet
headlines.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence has chosen Portuguese-made Tekever AR5 drones to succeed the troubled Watchkeeper program, marking a shift toward lighter, more flexible ISR capabilities for the British Army.

headlines.headline: Indonesia central bank governor Warjiyo resigns as rupiah hits record lows
headlines.summary: Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo stepped down before his term expires, following mounting criticism over the rupiah's plunge to record lows and accelerating capital flight from Southeast Asia's largest economy.

headlines.headline: Mediators report progress on diplomatic opening to de-escalate US-Iran conflict
headlines.summary: Qatar and Pakistan-led mediation efforts have made progress toward resuming US-Iran negotiations, with regional officials saying both sides appear open to a diplomatic off-ramp after 13 nights of strikes.

headlines.headline: US criticism of Malaysia Israel ban spotlights growing diplomatic disconnect
headlines.summary: US accusations that Malaysia's ban on Israelis entering the country is antisemitic are unlikely to change policy but underscore widening diplomatic rifts between Washington and Muslim-majority Southeast Asian nations.

headlines.headline: Marcos pushes tax exemptions and power reforms to revive Philippine growth
headlines.summary: Philippine President Marcos Jr. used his penultimate State of the Nation Address to propose raising income tax thresholds and energy reforms, aiming to stimulate an economy hit by the global oil crisis.

headlines.headline: Oil prices plunge over 9% as US-Iran pause raises de-escalation hopes
headlines.summary: Brent crude fell below $88 a barrel after the US halted attacks on Iran for a second consecutive night and Iran paused retaliatory strikes, sparking market optimism about a diplomatic resolution to the conflict.

headlines.headline: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike on vessel
headlines.summary: Iran Foreign Minister Araghchi said a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea that killed one sailor cannot go unanswered, accusing Israel of provoking the strike to drag Europe into a wider conflict.

headlines.headline: US appeals court upholds halt to Trump executive order creating federal voter list
headlines.summary: A federal appeals court upheld a lower court ruling blocking Trump's order to create a federal citizenship list for voters and restrict mail ballot delivery, rejecting the administration's effort to implement it ahead of the November midterms.

headlines.headline: Ukrainian startup Fire Point mass-producing cruise missiles, striking deep into Russia
headlines.summary: The Guardian reports Fire Point is manufacturing 100 Flamingo cruise missiles monthly and hundreds of drones daily, enabling Ukraine to sustain deep-strike operations inside Russia and closing the gap on Russian long-range attack capabilities.

headlines.headline: Argentina Milei calls Brazil Lula a thief and convict at Bolsonaro campaign rally
headlines.summary: Argentina president Javier Milei insulted Brazilian president Lula da Silva at a rally for Flavio Bolsonaro in Sao Paulo, prompting Brazil to recall its ambassador and escalating a diplomatic crisis between South America two largest economies.

headlines.headline: US Congress approves $500M for Taiwan defense as Trump continues hesitating on arms package
headlines.summary: The US House passed a bill including $500 million in Foreign Military Financing for Taiwan, signaling Congressional support even as President Trump withholds approval of a $14 billion weapons package after meeting Xi Jinping. Analysts say the allocation demonstrates Congress values Taiwan defense against Chinese expansion.

headlines.headline: Ukraine and US coordinate new peace push, hoping Russia accepts air truce
headlines.summary: Ukraine and the US are aligning on a new round of peace proposals to present to Moscow, with a US official saying the White House believes the Kremlin may now be more willing to accept at least a partial air ceasefire as Ukraine expands strikes inside Russia.

headlines.headline: Ukrainian drones strike export terminal and oil facilities in latest deep strike on Russia
headlines.summary: Ukrainian drones hit an export terminal in Rostov-on-Don on the Black Sea and oil facilities in Udmurtia and Yaroslavl Oblast, over 1,300 km from Ukrainian territory. Two people were killed and five injured in the Rostov attack, the governor reported.

headlines.headline: Britain’s new PM Burnham to host Zelensky as first foreign leader visit since taking office
headlines.summary: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will welcome Volodymyr Zelensky to London, making the Ukrainian president the first foreign leader to visit since Burnham replaced Keir Starmer. Zelensky is set to visit a British naval base and discuss continued defense support for Ukraine.

headlines.headline: Israeli ex-army chief Eisenkot emerges as main rival to Netanyahu ahead of October election
headlines.summary: Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot has surged as the principal challenger to Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of Israel’s October 27 general election. A Channel 12 poll puts his new Yashar party at 23 seats versus Likud’s 22, in what is widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu’s leadership.

headlines.headline: US and Iran pause strikes for third night as diplomatic efforts intensify
headlines.summary: The US military has paused airstrikes on Iran for a third consecutive night, with the UN ambassador saying Trump is giving talks space. Iran halted retaliatory attacks in response. Oil prices fell below $90 per barrel after hitting $100 last week. Oman-mediated technical talks on the Strait of Hormuz are progressing.

headlines.headline: Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs and Iran war hit sales
headlines.summary: The fast-fashion giant posted a $99m first-quarter loss versus $395m profit a year earlier, as the removal of the US de minimis tariff exemption and the Iran war disrupted deliveries and demand. Shein also reported the Iran conflict increased costs and caused shipping delays across multiple markets.

headlines.headline: Diplomatic off-ramp elusive as US-Iran war nears five months
headlines.summary: NPR analysis: After 13 consecutive nights of US strikes on Iran, a pause has opened diplomatic space but both sides remain far apart on Strait of Hormuz control. Iran and Oman held technical talks in Tehran over the weekend. Trump says he is not in a hurry despite midterm pressure over gas prices. Netanyahu visits the White House on Tuesday.

headlines.headline: Fire clouds threaten to worsen Europe wildfire crisis as new heatwave looms
headlines.summary: Pyrocumulonimbus clouds, fire-generated thunderstorms that can create lightning and unpredictable winds, have been observed for the first time in France as wildfires ravage the country and Spain. Experts warn another heatwave with temperatures up to 40C could hit France from Tuesday, threatening to intensify the crisis that has already forced 330,000 evacuations.

headlines.headline: Mali's separatist-al-Qaeda alliance reshapes Sahel conflict
headlines.summary: An unprecedented military partnership between the Azawad Liberation Front and al-Qaeda affiliate JNIM has transformed northern Mali conflict, with coordinated offensives challenging both the Malian army and Russia Africa Corps. The alliance poses the most serious battlefield threat to Bamako in years and has far-reaching implications for Sahel security.

headlines.headline: Macron convenes crisis meeting as wildfires threaten Bordeaux and ravage France-Spain
headlines.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron called an emergency cabinet meeting as wildfires closed to within 15km of Bordeaux, forcing over 220,000 evacuations. Spain simultaneously battles the largest wildfire in its recent history near Ávila, with 77,000 hectares scorched across both countries and 330,000 people evacuated total.

headlines.headline: Three killed in shooting at Seattle food festival near Space Needle
headlines.summary: A shooting at the Bite of Seattle food festival near the Space Needle left three dead and several injured, including a two-year-old boy. One suspect is in custody and police are searching for a second. Mayor Katie Wilson condemned the "horrific" violence.

headlines.headline: India's Gen Z "Cockroach" protests force education minister to resign
headlines.summary: India's education minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned after unprecedented youth-led protests by the Cockroach Janta Party swept the country, sparked by a leaked medical exam paper that forced 2 million students to retake tests. Analysts call it the first time in 12 years the Modi government lost control of the political narrative.

headlines.headline: Sudan army recaptures strategic Khartoum-el-Obeid highway from RSF
headlines.summary: Sudan's army announced it regained full control of the Al Sadarat highway linking Khartoum to the besieged city of el-Obeid, a key supply route held by the RSF since April 2023. The capture opens humanitarian access to 500,000 trapped civilians and blocks the RSF's push to seize North Kordofan.

headlines.headline: Israeli settlers torch mosques and homes in West Bank amid escalating violence
headlines.summary: Israeli settlers set fire to two mosques, cars and farmland in the occupied West Bank overnight, Palestinian officials say, following a deadly clash that killed six people near the village of Tal. The IDF arrested over 130 Palestinians in weekend raids as Netanyahu vowed "powerful action."

headlines.headline: Libya protests spread as civil disobedience campaign over power cuts paralyzes Tripoli
headlines.summary: Protesters shut roads, foreign ministry, and telecoms offices in Libyas capital as a civil disobedience campaign against 10-hour daily blackouts and deteriorating services spreads. The Souq Al-Jumaa Movement vowed to completely paralyse the government.

headlines.headline: German arms export licences for Israel surge amid submarine project focus
headlines.summary: German arms export approvals for Israel have risen dramatically, with a significant portion tied to a submarine project. The surge marks the latest development in Germanys evolving military relationship with Israel.

headlines.headline: Iran summons French ambassador over diplomat interference claims
headlines.summary: Iran summoned the French ambassador to Tehran, accusing two French diplomats of interfering in Irans internal affairs under the pretext of civil society engagement. France says the diplomats were detained and physically abused by Iranian security services.

headlines.headline: Pakistan monsoon floods kill over 100 as more rain forecast
headlines.summary: Death toll from Pakistans monsoon rains and floods has surpassed 100, with Punjabs monsoon season expected to continue through September and more rainfall predicted this week.

headlines.headline: Ukrainian drone unit hits 180 Russian vessels in Black Sea campaign
headlines.summary: Ukrainian drone units operating behind front lines have struck over 180 Russian vessels and sea-borne targets around Crimea in recent weeks, opening a new maritime front in the war. The campaign aims to isolate Crimea and raise the cost of Russian occupation.

headlines.headline: Berlin Pride ramming attack suspect shot and killed by police
headlines.summary: Abdul Ballout, a 21-year-old German-Lebanese citizen identified as the suspect in the deadly van attack at Berlin Pride that killed one and injured 29, was shot and killed by police during a confrontation in Spandau. German authorities called it a likely Islamist terror attack.

headlines.headline: UK PM Burnham pledges unwavering support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
headlines.summary: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will meet President Zelensky at a naval base and announce sharing of intellectual property for the Stone Cloak electronic warfare system, enabling Ukraine to produce the drone-jamming tech at scale.

headlines.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10 including child in Chernihiv
headlines.summary: Russian strikes killed six civilians in Ukraine including a 9-year-old girl at a Chernihiv supermarket, while Ukrainian drone attacks killed four in Russian-occupied Horlivka. UN says civilian casualties have climbed sharply in 2026.

headlines.headline: Ebola infections in DR Congo surge to 3,200 with 1,405 deaths
headlines.summary: The DRC Ebola outbreak has surged by 1,000 cases in just 10 days, reaching 3,200 infections and 1,405 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine, though Oxford began trials on an experimental vaccine this week.

headlines.headline: Trump imposes forced-labor tariffs on 60+ countries covering 99% of US imports
headlines.summary: The Trump administration has levied 10-12.5% tariffs on more than 60 countries using Section 301 forced-labor justifications, covering 99% of US imports. Critics say the move sidesteps Congress to replace tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court.

headlines.headline: US pauses Iran strikes for third night as military advisors warn of dwindling munitions
headlines.summary: The US has halted attacks on Iran for a third consecutive night after top military officials advised Trump the bombing campaign had reached its limits. Iran also paused retaliatory operations. Oil prices fell on the pause, and diplomatic talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue.

headlines.headline: Argentina Milei calls Brazil Lula a thief and convict at Bolsonaro rally, Brazil recalls ambassador
headlines.summary: Argentina president Javier Milei insulted Brazilian president Lula da Silva at a campaign rally for Flavio Bolsonaro in Sao Paulo, calling him a thief and convict. Brazil recalled its ambassador in response, escalating a diplomatic crisis between the two largest South American economies.

headlines.headline: Chinese chipmaker CXMT shares surge 470% in massive Shanghai IPO debut
headlines.summary: CXMT, China largest memory chipmaker, saw its shares soar as much as 472% in mainland China biggest IPO in years, raising at least 8.6 billion. The company market cap reached about 3.3 trillion yuan, making it the most valuable firm on a mainland Chinese exchange.

headlines.headline: Ukraine and US discuss air ceasefire proposal ahead of Trump-Zelenskyy meeting
headlines.summary: Ukrainian and US officials have discussed offering Russia an air ceasefire proposal ahead of a Trump-Zelenskyy meeting in Washington on Tuesday. The Kremlin said it was premature to comment. Meanwhile, Russia launched seven ballistic missiles and 136 drones at Ukraine overnight.

headlines.headline: Russia cancels St. Petersburg Navy Day parade for second year amid Ukrainian drone threat
headlines.summary: Russia has canceled its annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg for the second consecutive year, as Ukraine's deep-strike drone capabilities put even heavily defended Russian cities at risk.

headlines.headline: Civilian grain ship sinks in Black Sea after Russian missile strike
headlines.summary: A civilian cargo ship sank near Odesa after being struck by Russian missiles on July 19 while transporting grain, highlighting the ongoing threat to food shipping routes.

headlines.headline: Germany pulls back two navy ships from Strait of Hormuz as Iran war drags on
headlines.summary: German defense leaders have pulled back two navy ships that were earmarked for a post-war mission in the Strait of Hormuz, citing little hope for a near-term resolution of the Iran conflict.

headlines.headline: Trump's Iran strikes hit US strategy to contain China via Chabahar port
headlines.summary: US air strikes on Iran have damaged the Indian-backed port of Chabahar, long seen as a counterweight to China's Belt and Road influence, undermining Washington's own containment strategy in the region.

headlines.headline: China blacklists Polish university in retaliation for EU dual-use export controls
headlines.summary: China has placed Wroclaw University of Science and Technology on its export control blacklist alongside defense firms, retaliating against the latest round of EU sanctions targeting dual-use technology.

headlines.headline: Iran Warns Ukraine of Retaliation After Deadly Caspian Sea Strike
headlines.summary: Iran Foreign Minister Araghchi said a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea that killed one sailor cannot go unanswered, accusing Israel of provoking the strike. Iran summoned Ukraine’s charge d’affaires and a senior lawmaker warned Kyiv could face retaliation.

headlines.headline: Chinese Chipmaker CXMT Surges 470% on Debut, Becomes Mainland Most Valuable Listed Firm
headlines.summary: ChangXin Memory Technologies shares soared more than 470% in their Shanghai Star Market debut, pushing CXMT market valuation to around 3.3 trillion yuan ($487bn) and making it the most valuable listed company in mainland China. The spectacular IPO comes despite a global tech selloff and highlights Chinese investor appetite for homegrown chipmakers.

headlines.headline: Trump Border Czar Probes Vetting Failures After Deadly ICE Shooting in Maine
headlines.summary: Trump border czar Tom Homan said the vetting of an ICE officer involved in the deadly shooting of a Colombian native in Maine is under internal review, after the officer’s relatives revealed a history of mental health struggles and violent behaviour. Homan acknowledged the officer may never have passed proper vetting.

headlines.headline: Saudi Arabia and Houthis Trade Fire as US Fires on Tanker in Hormuz Strait
headlines.summary: Iran-backed Houthis claimed a missile attack on the Saudi city of Jizan in retaliation for Saudi airstrikes on Hodeida. Meanwhile, the US military said it fired on and disabled a tanker in the Gulf of Oman attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports. No overnight US or Iran strikes were reported for the first time in two weeks.

headlines.headline: Wildfires Force 300,000+ to Flee as Flames Threaten Bordeaux
headlines.summary: Massive wildfires in southwest France have forced over 300,000 people to evacuate across France and Spain, with fires creeping toward the city of Bordeaux. French President Macron called an emergency cabinet meeting as another heatwave approaches.

headlines.headline: Romania Shoots Down Third Russian Drone in Three Days, Summons Ambassador
headlines.summary: Romania shot down a third Russian drone in as many days, prompting Bucharest to summon Russia's ambassador. The repeated airspace violations raise concerns about the Russia-Ukraine war spilling over into NATO territory.

headlines.headline: Israel Launches Military Incursion Into Syria as UN Condemns Violations
headlines.summary: Israeli forces advanced into southwestern Syrian villages, setting up a checkpoint and dropping leaflets warning residents. UN Secretary-General Guterres condemned the violations of Syria's sovereignty during a visit to the country.

headlines.headline: Trump Paused Iran Attacks to Give Diplomacy Space, Says US Ambassador
headlines.summary: The US paused attacks on Iran for a second consecutive night to allow diplomatic talks space, according to UN Ambassador Mike Waltz. Iran also halted retaliatory attacks. Oil prices hit $100/barrel as the conflict nears its fifth month.

headlines.headline: Typhoon Noul — Strongest to Hit China This Year — Lashes Hong Kong
headlines.summary: Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, becoming the strongest typhoon to hit the country in 2026 so far. Hong Kong airport cancelled around 360 flights as scaffolding collapsed in powerful winds. No injuries reported.

headlines.headline: Zelensky struggles to contain political crisis after sacking defence minister Fedorov
headlines.summary: President Zelensky faces ongoing protests after removing popular defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov, who rejected alternative posts and hinted at presidential ambitions. The appointment of Maj Gen Drapatyi as commander-in-chief has been welcomed, but Fedorov supporters continue daily street demonstrations demanding his reinstatement.

headlines.headline: Russia kills 10 in ballistic missile strike on drone exhibition near Kyiv
headlines.summary: Russian forces fired three ballistic missiles at a drone technology exhibition near Kyiv, killing at least 10 people and wounding around 100. The targeted event was attended by prominent members of Ukraine defence industry, raising questions about operational security.

headlines.headline: Israel approves international stabilisation force for Gaza under Trump peace plan
headlines.summary: Israel security cabinet approved the entry of an International Stabilisation Force into Gaza, part of Trump 20-point peace plan. The force will include 200 personnel from friendly countries and operate in coordination with the Israeli military, with Israel retaining authority over which nations can participate.

headlines.headline: Former Honduran President Hernández returns home after Trump pardon, faces domestic charges
headlines.summary: Juan Orlando Hernández, convicted in the US for drug trafficking and sentenced to 45 years, returned to Honduras after Trump pardoned him claiming the trial was a Biden-era setup. He now faces fraud and money-laundering charges in Honduras, though activists fear the prosecution will be a sham.

headlines.headline: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by German police
headlines.summary: Abdul Ballout, a 21-year-old German-Lebanese citizen suspected of driving a van into a Pride crowd in Berlin, was shot and killed by police after rushing at officers with a knife. Germany has raised its threat level following the attack that killed one woman and injured 29.

headlines.headline: UK PM Burnham pledges unwavering Ukraine support, shares electronic warfare tech
headlines.summary: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham made Zelenskyy his first international visitor, announcing the sharing of Britain's "Stone Cloak" drone-jamming technology IP with Ukraine for domestic production, alongside new cruise missile development plans.

headlines.headline: US-Iran fighting paused but both sides face uncertain off-ramp
headlines.summary: After nearly two weeks of daily strikes, the US has paused bombing Iran for two nights. Diplomatic efforts continue over the Strait of Hormuz, but Netanyahu's upcoming White House visit and dwindling munitions concerns add uncertainty to whether the pause becomes lasting peace.

headlines.headline: Syria's al-Sharaa seeks security deal with Israel in exclusive interview
headlines.summary: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa told Al Jazeera that Damascus is actively pursuing a security agreement with Israel that could serve as a gateway to comprehensive peace, while insisting it would not compromise Syria's claim to the occupied Golan Heights.

headlines.headline: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of fomenting hate after ICC arrest threat
headlines.summary: Israeli PM Netanyahu said he would attend the UN General Assembly in New York this fall despite Mayor Mamdani's earlier threat to arrest him on ICC war crimes charges. Netanyahu accused Mamdani of dividing New Yorkers, referencing recent hate crime stabbings in the city.

headlines.headline: Multiple people shot at Seattle food festival near Space Needle
headlines.summary: Several people were injured in a shooting at the Bite of Seattle festival at Seattle Center, a popular annual event drawing hundreds of thousands. Police urged people to avoid the area as the investigation continued.

headlines.headline: Cuba president accuses US of genocide and seeking takeover amid crippling oil embargo
headlines.summary: President Miguel Diaz-Canel denounced the US oil embargo — in place since January — as genocide at a rally marking the 73rd anniversary of the Cuban Revolution. The embargo has caused daily blackouts exceeding 20 hours, with major companies withdrawing from the country.

headlines.headline: US appeals court upholds block on Trump executive order creating federal voter list
headlines.summary: A federal appeals court upheld a lower court ruling halting Trumps executive order that would create a federal citizenship voter list and restrict mail ballot delivery. The 1st Circuit rejected the administrations attempt to implement the order in 23 states that sued.

headlines.headline: Macron calls crisis cabinet meeting as wildfire closes in on Bordeaux
headlines.summary: French President Macron convened an emergency cabinet meeting as Europes devastating wildfires edged within 15km of Bordeaux. Over 220,000 people have been evacuated in southwestern France alone, with firefighters describing a David-versus-Goliath battle against a fire creating its own thunderstorms.

headlines.headline: Argentina Milei calls Brazils Lula a thief and convict, Brazil recalls ambassador
headlines.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei insulted Brazilian President Lula da Silva at a Sao Paulo rally for right-wing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, calling him a thief and convict. Brazil responded by recalling its ambassador from Buenos Aires, escalating a diplomatic crisis between the two largest South American economies.

headlines.headline: Russia cancels annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg as Ukrainian deep-strike capabilities threaten major cities
headlines.summary: Russia has canceled its annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg for the second year in a row, as Ukraine increasing deep-strike capabilities put even heavily defended Russian cities at risk.

headlines.headline: Russia seeking 30,000 more troops from North Korea, Zelenskyy says
headlines.summary: Moscow and Pyongyang signed a mutual assistance pact in 2024, and Zelenskyy says Russia now wants 30,000 additional North Korean troops for the war in Ukraine.

headlines.headline: China blacklists Polish university on European dual-use export controls list
headlines.summary: China has added a Polish university to its dual-use exports blacklist, signaling escalating tech tensions between Beijing and European institutions over sensitive technology transfers.

headlines.headline: Civilian cargo ship carrying grain sinks in Black Sea near Odesa after Russian missile strike
headlines.summary: A civilian cargo ship sank on July 26 in the Black Sea near Odesa after being struck by Russian missiles on July 19 while transporting grain, marking another attack on civilian shipping.

headlines.headline: US Air Force EA-37B electronic warfare aircraft arrive at RAF Fairford as Iran threatens UK base
headlines.summary: EA-37B Compass Call aircraft have deployed to RAF Fairford in the UK, a key hub for USAF bomber missions against Iran, as Tehran threatens to attack the British air base.

headlines.headline: Pentagon quietly removes 4 US troop deaths from Iran war casualty count
headlines.summary: The Defense Department removed four American soldiers killed during renewed Iran fighting from its official war toll, reclassifying them under a new "Overseas Operations" category. The move raises questions about transparency as the Trump administration faces growing scrutiny over the conflict's human cost.

headlines.headline: India Cockroach Janta protests force education minister resignation in blow to Modi
headlines.summary: A Gen Z movement dubbed the Cockroach Janta Party forced the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan after leaked exam papers sparked mass protests and student suicides. The unprecedented uprising poses the biggest challenge to Modi's grip on power since he took office in 2014.

headlines.headline: Brazil denies visas to US officials amid election interference concerns
headlines.summary: Brazil's Foreign Ministry denied visas to two US State Department officials who sought to travel to Brasilia, calling their visit an attempt to cast doubt on October's presidential elections. The move escalates diplomatic tensions between the Lula and Trump administrations over tariffs and election integrity.

headlines.headline: Ukraine and US discuss air ceasefire proposal ahead of Trump-Zelensky meeting
headlines.summary: Ukrainian and US officials have discussed proposing an air ceasefire to Russia, Reuters reports, ahead of Volodymyr Zelenskyy's visit to Washington on Tuesday. The Kremlin called it premature to comment. Romania shot down a third Russian drone in three days, and a cargo ship sank off Odesa after a Russian attack killed 9 crew.

headlines.headline: US pauses Iran strikes for second night as military advises against escalation
headlines.summary: The US paused airstrikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump about dwindling munitions stockpiles and the limits of the bombing campaign. Iran also halted retaliatory operations. Diplomatic negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid a two-week surge in violence that killed 4 US soldiers.

headlines.headline: Iran says Ukrainian attack on vessel in Caspian Sea killed a sailor
headlines.summary: Iran confirmed that a Ukrainian naval drone strike on a vessel in the Caspian Sea killed one sailor, marking an escalation of the Ukraine-Russia conflict into the Caspian region and raising concerns about the war expanding beyond the Black Sea.

headlines.headline: Berlin Pride attack was Islamist terror, says German interior minister; suspect shot dead
headlines.summary: Germany declared the deadly ramming attack near Berlin Pride an Islamist terror act. The suspect, a German-Lebanese citizen and IS supporter, was shot dead by police after a 24-hour manhunt. One woman was killed and 29 injured.

headlines.headline: Bordeaux under threat as France and Spain battle unprecedented wildfires
headlines.summary: Wildfires advanced to within 15 km of Bordeaux as France and Spain battled blazes that forced over 300,000 people to evacuate. France called the situation unprecedented; Avila suffered Spain worst wildfire in recent history with over 50,000 hectares burned.

headlines.headline: Kazakhstan Calls for Freezing Russia-Ukraine War as Drone Attacks Halt Oil Exports
headlines.summary: President Tokayev urged freezing the Russia-Ukraine conflict beside Putin in Omsk, while Kazakhstan slashed oil production after Ukrainian drone attacks forced its main Black Sea export terminal to shut down.

headlines.headline: Lebanon Accuses Israel of Obstructing Troop Deployment in Southern Pilot Zones
headlines.summary: The Lebanese army says Israel is violating withdrawal agreements by continuing shellings and bulldozing operations, preventing Lebanese forces from taking over pilot zone villages in the south.

headlines.headline: Netanyahu Vows to Visit New York Despite ICC Warrant, Accuses Mayor Mamdani of Fomenting Hate
headlines.summary: The Israeli PM said he will speak at the UN General Assembly this fall, calling ICC war crimes charges bogus and accusing NYC Mayor Mamdani of turning groups against each other. Mamdani had previously threatened to arrest Netanyahu.

headlines.headline: New UK PM Burnham Pledges Unwavering Ukraine Support Ahead of Zelensky Visit
headlines.summary: Andy Burnham announced sharing of the UK's Stone Cloak electronic warfare IP with Ukraine as President Zelensky becomes the new prime minister's first international visitor at a naval base meeting.

headlines.headline: Israeli Settlers Set Fire to Mosques and Farmland in West Bank Amid Escalating Violence
headlines.summary: Settlers attacked two villages overnight, burning mosques under construction and vandalizing property, following a deadly clash in Tal village that killed four Palestinians and two Israelis.

headlines.headline: Romania shoots down third Russian drone in three days, summons ambassador
headlines.summary: Romania shot down a third drone in as many days over the Black Sea and summoned Russia's ambassador over repeated airspace violations. The incidents raise fears of the Ukraine war spilling over into NATO territory, with Romania's president identifying at least one drone as a Russian Shahed model.

headlines.headline: US pauses Iran attacks for second night as military advised Trump to halt bombing
headlines.summary: The US has paused strikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump that the campaign had reached the limits of its effectiveness and munitions stockpiles were dwindling. Iran also halted retaliatory attacks. Diplomatic talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid fears of energy supply disruption.

headlines.headline: Israel launches military incursion into Syria as UN chief demands withdrawal
headlines.summary: Israeli forces advanced into villages in southwestern Syria, setting up checkpoints and dropping leaflets warning residents, as UN Secretary-General Guterres visited Damascus and condemned violations of Syria's sovereignty. Guterres called for all sanctions on Syria to be lifted immediately.

headlines.headline: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by police during manhunt
headlines.summary: German police shot and killed Abdul Ballout, the 21-year-old suspected of driving a van into a Berlin Pride crowd and stabbing people, killing one woman and injuring at least 29. Authorities called it a likely Islamist terror attack. Germany raised its threat level in response.

headlines.headline: More than 360,000 evacuated as record wildfires ravage France and Spain
headlines.summary: Wildfires in southwestern France and Spain have forced over 360,000 people to flee their homes, with 55,000 evacuated overnight near Bordeaux alone. France has seen 42,000 hectares burned in one of its largest fires since WWII. Spain declared a national emergency as fires spread toward Madrid and Valencia.

headlines.headline: Hezbollah says Iran will not sign final deal unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon
headlines.summary: Hezbollah stated Iran has pledged not to sign a final nuclear deal with Washington unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon, as Iran's foreign minister called Israel's continued troop presence a breach of the US-Iran memorandum of understanding.

perspectives.angle: Lebanon Suffers Deadliest Spillover of the Regional War as Israel-Hezbollah Conflict Takes Heavy Toll
perspectives.summary: A Reuters factbox details the devastating costs to Lebanon from the latest Israel-Hezbollah war — the deadliest spillover of the regional conflict triggered by US-Israeli strikes on Iran more than three months ago.

headlines.headline: The Iran war permanently altered the global economy
headlines.summary: The global economic order has been reshaped by the US-Iran conflict, with shifts in oil markets, trade routes, and supply chains that are unlikely to simply revert to pre-war patterns even as a peace deal emerges.

perspectives.angle: The Iran War Permanently Altered the Global Economy
perspectives.summary: The New York Times analyzes how the US-Iran war has fundamentally reshaped global trade patterns and oil markets, arguing that even with a peace deal, the economic order is unlikely to revert to its pre-war state.

headlines.headline: Zelenskiy says G7 agreed Russia is not winning the war, discussed more sanctions
headlines.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskiy said G7 leaders agreed at the France summit that Russia is not winning its war in Ukraine and discussed additional sanctions to bring Moscow to negotiations.

perspectives.angle: Zelenskiy says G7 agreed Russia is not winning, discussed more sanctions
perspectives.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskiy said G7 leaders agreed that Russia is not winning the war in Ukraine and discussed additional sanctions to bring Moscow to the negotiating table.

headlines.headline: Trump says Iran deal makes clear Tehran will never have a nuclear weapon
headlines.summary: President Trump maintained the interim accord with Iran makes clear Tehran would never be allowed to develop a nuclear weapon, and suggested Syria could be better positioned to disarm Hezbollah.

perspectives.angle: Trump says Iran deal to be public soon, will rule out nuclear weapon for Tehran
perspectives.summary: Details of the US-Iran interim deal emerged at the G7 summit, with Trump saying the accord will be made public soon and will prohibit Iran from developing a nuclear weapon. How the deal will work in practice remains unclear.

headlines.headline: EU lawmakers set to approve tougher migrant detention and deportation rules
headlines.summary: European lawmakers are giving final approval to stricter migration rules that grant authorities broader powers to detain irregular arrivals and create expanded deportation facilities. The measures represent a significant hardening of EU migration policy amid rising anti-immigration sentiment across the bloc.

headlines.headline: Israeli army prepares for prolonged Lebanon occupation despite US-Iran peace pact
headlines.summary: Security sources report that Israeli troops remain ready to stay in occupied Lebanese territory if instructed by political leadership, even as the US-Iran peace deal moves toward signing. The stance contradicts Iranian FM Araghchi's demand for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as part of any agreement.

perspectives.angle: Israel Refuses Lebanon Withdrawal Despite Iran Deal Pressure
perspectives.summary: Israel says it will not withdraw forces from Lebanon even as Iran insists the US-Iran peace deal requires Israeli troops to leave. Hezbollah claims Iran has pledged to pursue Israeli withdrawal as a condition for any final nuclear agreement.

headlines.headline: UN chief Guterres visits Haiti as gang violence deepens humanitarian crisis
headlines.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres visited Haiti as gang violence continues to worsen the country's humanitarian crisis, with thousands displaced and basic services collapsing. The visit highlights international concern over the Caribbean nation's descent into chaos.

headlines.headline: Singapore May exports surge 38% driven by AI-related demand
headlines.summary: Singapore's non-oil domestic exports jumped 38.4% year-on-year in May, fueled by robust AI-related shipments. The surge signals sustained Asian tech supply chain momentum even amid global trade uncertainties from US tariff policies and geopolitical tensions.

headlines.headline: Israeli minister announces military takeover of Hebron administration
headlines.summary: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich says Israel has transferred authority over Hebron to the army, a significant escalation in West Bank control that could further complicate regional peace efforts.

headlines.headline: Brazilian court convicts Eduardo Bolsonaro for seeking US interference in domestic affairs
headlines.summary: A Brazilian court found Eduardo Bolsonaro guilty of attempting to enlist US government interference in Brazil, a case tied to broader tensions between Brasilia and Washington over tariffs and judicial sanctions.

headlines.headline: Damaged Kyiv monastery from Russian strike will take two years to restore
headlines.summary: Ukrainian officials say the nearly 1,000-year-old monastery in Kyiv, damaged by what Ukraine described as a deliberate Russian strike, requires around two years of restoration work.

perspectives.angle: Historic Kyiv Pechersk Lavra Monastery Set Ablaze in Russian Strike
perspectives.summary: A nearly 1,000-year-old monastery — one of Ukraine's most sacred cultural sites with golden domes towering over Kyiv for centuries — was set ablaze during a Russian attack. Firefighters worked to contain the damage to the historic cathedral famed for its frescoes and silver artefacts.

headlines.headline: Anti-capitalist protesters descend on G7 summit in France
headlines.summary: Anti-capitalist demonstrations unfolded at the G7 summit in Evian-les-Bains as world leaders discussed global security, the Iran deal, and economic policy inside the heavily secured venue.

perspectives.angle: G7 Summit Begins in France as Anti-G7 Protests Erupt in Geneva
perspectives.summary: World leaders convened for the G7 summit in France as thousands of protesters clashed with police in Geneva. Swiss authorities deployed water cannons and tear gas to disperse demonstrators ahead of the meeting.

headlines.headline: G7 leaders discuss granting trusted partners access to cutting-edge US AI models
headlines.summary: G7 leaders discussed a plan to grant select trusted partners access to advanced AI models from US firms such as Anthropic, three diplomatic sources said, potentially opening a path around restrictions on non-American use of the technology.

headlines.headline: Israeli drone strikes kill at least 4 in southern Lebanon
headlines.summary: Israeli drone strikes targeted three vehicles in southern Lebanon, killing at least four people and wounding others, Lebanons National News Agency reported. The strikes come amid ongoing tensions even as the US-Iran peace deal raises hopes for regional de-escalation.

perspectives.angle: Hezbollah Says It Repelled Israeli Force Advancing in Southern Lebanon
perspectives.summary: Hezbollah announced it repelled an Israeli force attempting to advance in southern Lebanon, raising fears of escalation along the Israel-Lebanon border despite the broader Iran ceasefire.

headlines.headline: Trump-backed candidate loses Georgia governor runoff in upset
headlines.summary: Georgia Republican voters rejected President Trumps preferred nominee for the competitive open governor race, delivering a rare primary endorsement defeat. Rep. Mike Collins won the Republican Senate runoff and will face Sen. Jon Ossoff in a closely watched matchup.

headlines.headline: White House talking points on Iran deal dont match reality, AP analysis finds
headlines.summary: The White House proclaimed major victories in its Iran talking points, including Iran agreeing to never have a nuclear weapon and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. But the AP found several claims go against realities on the ground, especially regarding what Israel has agreed to in Lebanon. The MOU remains a closely guarded secret even among Republican allies.

headlines.headline: Lebanon prepares new round of talks with Israel as president and PM coordinate strategy
headlines.summary: Lebanese leaders discussed preparations for a new round of negotiations with Israel next week, as the US-Iran deal raises prospects for broader regional de-escalation and Israel-Hezbollah tensions ease.

headlines.headline: Trump to host Iraqi Prime Minister at White House in mid-July
headlines.summary: US President Trump will host Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi at the White House next month, as Washington reshapes Middle East alliances following the Iran peace deal.

headlines.headline: Canada Carney raises China EV tariffs with Trump at G7, announces new Russia sanctions
headlines.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney held a short but intense discussion with Trump on China EV trade at the G7 summit, while also announcing fresh sanctions against Russia over the Ukraine war.

headlines.headline: US holds off blacklisting China's DeepSeek and 100+ flagged firms to avoid escalating Beijing tensions
headlines.summary: The Trump administration has delayed adding DeepSeek, CXMT, and over 100 Chinese companies flagged as national security risks to the trade blacklist, seeking to avoid further escalation with Beijing amid fragile diplomatic ties.

headlines.headline: European leaders test Iran deal risks at G7, urge rethink on Ukraine strategy
headlines.summary: European allies at the G7 summit raised concerns about the US-Iran interim deal's implications while pushing Trump to reconsider his approach to Ukraine, as the summit revealed persistent transatlantic divisions.

perspectives.angle: European leaders warn Trump on Iran deal risks, push Ukraine rethink at G7 summit
perspectives.summary: European leaders told Trump at the G7 summit in Evian that a superficial interim Iran deal risks entrenching Tehran's nuclear and missile programs, while pressing him to rethink his Ukraine strategy and stand behind Kyiv.

headlines.headline: Trump says Ukraine war has no impact on US as G7 reveals persistent ally divisions
headlines.summary: President Trump downplayed the Ukraine war's significance for the US at the G7 summit, even as allied leaders pushed for stronger collective action and the mood around the Iran deal lightened the overall agenda.

perspectives.angle: Trump tells G7 Ukraine war has "no impact" on the United States
perspectives.summary: At the G7 summit in Evian, President Trump distanced the US from the Ukraine conflict, telling allies the war has no effect on America — a stark signal to European partners who have relied on US security guarantees for decades.

headlines.headline: Trump vows to release text of Iran agreement within days as key questions remain unanswered
headlines.summary: At the G7 summit, Trump promised to publish the full text of the US-Iran interim deal soon, but critical details about enforcement, timelines, and Israel's Lebanon withdrawal demands remain unresolved.

headlines.headline: Oil prices fall 5% to 3-month low on Strait of Hormuz reopening hopes
headlines.summary: Crude prices dropped sharply for a second straight session as details of the US-Iran interim deal emerged, including an agreement to allow Iran to sell oil and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

perspectives.angle: World largest tanker operator says Hormuz oil flow may take weeks or a month to resume
perspectives.summary: The CEO of Japan Mitsui OSK Lines, the worlds largest tanker operator, cautioned that many operators will wait before resuming Strait of Hormuz transits even after a deal, delaying full oil flow recovery.

headlines.headline: Gold holds gains as US and Iran prepare to sign interim peace deal
headlines.summary: Gold prices held steady as markets assessed the implications of the US-Iran interim peace deal, which could ease global inflationary pressures and reshape energy markets.

headlines.headline: British couple recount Russian warship firing warning shots near their boat
headlines.summary: A retired British couple described warning shots fired near their vessel by a Russian warship in international waters, highlighting ongoing maritime tensions between Russia and Western civilians.

headlines.headline: Australia relaxes Middle East travel warnings after US-Iran interim deal
headlines.summary: Australia lowered travel advisories for Bahrain, Israel, Kuwait, Qatar, and the UAE following the US-Iran interim peace agreement, though it warned the security situation could still deteriorate rapidly with little warning.

headlines.headline: US-Iran deal permits oil sales, includes access to  billion private fund
headlines.summary: Details of the US-Iran interim agreement reveal Tehran will be allowed to sell oil upon signing and gain access to a  billion private fund. Trump also intensified criticism of Netanyahu over the Lebanon campaign.

headlines.headline: Latin America and Europe are bystanders in the US-China AI race, says Lula adviser
headlines.summary: Brazilian president Lula's top adviser Celso Amorim told a Rio conference that the Global South must respond through BRICS, framing rare earths and data sovereignty as strategic priorities in the emerging AI contest.

headlines.headline: Iran War — Energy Shock or Geopolitical Turning Point?
headlines.summary: Reuters commentary examines whether the Iran war will be remembered as a temporary energy shock or a lasting watershed moment for global crude oil and LNG markets, as a US-Iran peace deal promises to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.headline: G7 Leaders Meet Zelenskyy, Qatar and UAE Heads on Summit First Full Day
headlines.summary: NPR reports that President Trump met with G7 leaders as well as Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and the heads of Qatar and UAE during the key summit first full day, as allies push Ukraine back onto the agenda.

headlines.headline: Trump denies US will invest money in Iran, says $300B fund report is "ridiculous"
headlines.summary: At the G7 summit, President Trump told reporters the US is "not investing any money in Iran" and dismissed reports of a $300 billion investment fund. VP Vance said any fund would come from the Gulf Coalition, not US taxpayers.

perspectives.angle: Trump dismisses reports of $300B Iran reconstruction fund as fake news
perspectives.summary: President Trump pushed back on reports that a $300 billion reconstruction fund for Iran would be part of the peace agreement, casting doubt on one of the most controversial rumored elements of the deal.

headlines.headline: G7 allies push Ukraine back onto agenda as Zelenskyy joins leaders for talks
headlines.summary: Ukraine's allies at the G7 summit scrambled to refocus attention on the war with Russia, which had been overshadowed by the Iran conflict. Zelenskyy joined leaders for a 75-minute working session. The UK announced new sanctions on Russia's shadow fleet and seized a Russian vessel in the English Channel.

headlines.headline: UK announces new sanctions on Russian shadow fleet, seizes vessel in English Channel
headlines.summary: The UK unveiled a new package of sanctions targeting Russia's shadow oil fleet and finance networks. British troops seized a Russian shadow fleet vessel in the English Channel for the first time. The move comes as G7 leaders push to squeeze Russian oil revenues.

headlines.headline: US diplomats face fallout over Islamic State prisoner transfers from Syria
headlines.summary: American diplomats are aware of fresh allegations regarding Islamic State terrorism detainees transferred from Syria, raising concerns about security and accountability as the US reshapes its Middle East posture.

headlines.headline: China cruising to become world top tourism market with visa waivers and high-speed rail
headlines.summary: Visa waivers for over 70 countries and surging domestic travel are pushing China toward overtaking the US as the worlds largest tourism market, reshaping global tourism patterns.

headlines.headline: Hong Kong Science Park partners with SenseTime to build home-grown AI data center
headlines.summary: Hong Kong Science Park and SenseTime are partnering to build a domestic AI data center targeting 40,000 petaflops by 2030, amid growing competition in the regional AI infrastructure race.

headlines.headline: Canada imposes sanctions on Russias shadow fleet and energy revenues at G7
headlines.summary: PM Carney announced new sanctions targeting Russias shadow fleet, energy revenues, defense-industrial sector, and disinformation entities at the G7 summit, as allies push to refocus pressure on Moscow over Ukraine.

headlines.headline: White House Iran deal talking points often dont meet reality, AP finds
headlines.summary: An AP analysis finds that the White Houses claims of accomplishments in the Iran war deal frequently diverge from the actual terms and realities of the agreement.

headlines.headline: Deal or no deal, oil prices will stay high for months
headlines.summary: Even with the US-Iran peace accord, The Economist reports that global oil prices are likely to remain elevated for months as physical supply chains and shipping routes take time to normalize.

headlines.headline: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high, signals further hikes ahead
headlines.summary: The Bank of Japan raised interest rates to their highest level in 31 years in a landmark policy normalization step, signaling readiness to tighten further as it focuses on taming price pressures from the Iran-war-induced energy shock.

perspectives.angle: Bank of Japan raises key interest rate to 1%, highest in three decades
perspectives.summary: The Bank of Japan raised its benchmark rate to 1%, a 31-year high, citing inflation pressures from the Middle East conflict and a weak yen. The Nikkei 225 briefly topped 70,000 for the first time before retreating.

headlines.headline: Trump meets world leaders at G7 as Iran deal takes center stage
headlines.summary: World leaders sought clarity on the Iran deal framework at the G7 summit, with Iran demanding Israel withdraw from Lebanon as part of the agreement, while Trump said Netanyahu needs to be "more responsible."

perspectives.angle: G7 Allies Seek Clarity on Iran Deal as Trump Arrives in France
perspectives.summary: World leaders gathering at the G7 summit in France pressed for details on the US-Iran memorandum of understanding, with questions remaining about enforcement, the Strait of Hormuz reopening timeline, and Israel-Hezbollah tensions that could threaten the deal.

headlines.headline: US Military Plans Permanent Weapons Stockpile in Australia
headlines.summary: US Navy documents reveal advanced planning for a large war-ready weapons stockpile in Australia, with $30 million allocated to build warehouses and offices. The move signals deeper US military posture in the Indo-Pacific.

headlines.headline: Ukrainian Su-24 Bomber Crashes, Both Pilots Killed
headlines.summary: A Ukrainian Su-24 bomber crashed in Khmelnytskyi Oblast on the evening of June 16, killing both the pilot and navigator. The Air Force confirmed the incident, with the cause under investigation.

headlines.headline: Trump signals swift return of sanctions on Russian oil as G7 refocuses on Ukraine
headlines.summary: At the G7 summit in France, Trump indicated he may reimpose sanctions on Russian oil soon, as world leaders pushed Ukraine back to the top of the agenda alongside the Iran deal.

perspectives.angle: Trump signals swift return of sanctions on Russian oil as G7 refocuses on Ukraine
perspectives.summary: The US could soon reimpose sanctions on Russian oil shipments after President Trump and fellow G7 leaders moved to refocus on Ukraine, with the Iran peace deal creating conditions for tighter enforcement. Canada also announced new sanctions targeting Russias shadow fleet and energy revenues.

headlines.headline: Ukrainian drone strike halts operations at Moscow oil refinery
headlines.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack sparked a fire at Moscows largest fuel-supplying refinery, halting operations. Zelenskiy described the strike as coercion to push Russia toward peace talks.

perspectives.angle: Ukrainian drone strike halts operations at Moscow oil refinery
perspectives.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack sparked a fire and halted operations at the largest fuel supplier to the Moscow region, marking a significant escalation in Ukrainian strikes deep inside Russian territory amid the G7 summit.

headlines.headline: Trump insists Strait of Hormuz will open toll-free under Iran deal
headlines.summary: Speaking at the G7 summit, Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz would reopen toll-free under the US-Iran deal, as oil prices fell 5% to a three-month low on hopes of restored shipping.

perspectives.angle: Strait of Hormuz sees mini exodus of shipping as Vance insists peace deal benefits US
perspectives.summary: Ships are rushing to leave the Strait of Hormuz amid uncertainty over the US-Iran peace deal terms, while Vice President JD Vance defended the agreement as advantageous for American interests.

headlines.headline: ECB will stay proactive on inflation even after Iran deal, Lane says
headlines.summary: ECB chief economist Philip Lane said the central bank will remain proactive in fighting high inflation despite falling energy prices following the US-Iran deal, signaling rates may stay elevated.

perspectives.angle: ECB chief Lagarde welcomes Iran ceasefire but warns inflation may persist
perspectives.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde called the US-Iran ceasefire good news that could help reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but several ECB colleagues cautioned it would not immediately bring down elevated euro zone inflation.

headlines.headline: Iran soccer team forced to train in Tijuana after being blocked from U.S. entry
headlines.summary: Iran World Cup squad was denied entry to train in the United States amid wartime tensions, finding an unlikely welcome in the Mexican border city of Tijuana — a story where sport and geopolitics collide.

headlines.headline: Anti-capitalist protesters clash with security at G7 summit in Evian
headlines.summary: Thousands of anti-capitalist demonstrators protested near the G7 summit venue in Evian-les-Bains, opposing what they called the elite global order — a familiar backdrop for the annual gathering of world leaders.

headlines.headline: AI price war deepens across China as competition intensifies between tech giants
headlines.summary: Narrowing capability gaps between AI models and falling service costs are fueling a price war among Chinese tech firms, with analysts predicting further reductions as competition heats up.

headlines.headline: Harris says Trump DOJ investigation of Newsom fits pattern of targeting political enemies
headlines.summary: Former Vice President Kamala Harris condemned the Trump administration investigation into California Governor Gavin Newsom, calling it part of a broader pattern of using the Justice Department against political opponents.

headlines.headline: Swiss luxury resort chosen as venue for US-Iran deal signing ceremony
headlines.summary: The Bürgenstock resort above Lake Lucerne in Switzerland, long favored by world leaders and celebrities, will host the formal signing of the US-Iran peace agreement scheduled for June 19.

perspectives.angle: Trump says next phase of Iran deal will be "easier" as Geneva signing set for June 19
perspectives.summary: Speaking at the G7 summit, Trump expressed confidence that the Iran peace deal's next phase would proceed smoothly, with a formal signing ceremony planned in Geneva on June 19 after the framework MOU was electronically signed.

headlines.headline: Philippines unprepared for a mega-quake despite Mindanao disaster, experts warn
headlines.summary: A 50-year-old building code and stalled political action leave the Philippines vulnerable to a catastrophic earthquake, with scientists warning the recent Mindanao quake is only a preview of a larger event.

headlines.headline: Trump rebukes Israel at G7, suggests Syria should handle Hezbollah instead
headlines.summary: President Trump publicly criticized Israel's prolonged and deadly campaign in Lebanon, saying the war is "too long" and suggesting Damascus — not the IDF — should deal with Hezbollah, a proposal that could reshape the Levant's security landscape.

headlines.headline: Economist briefing: Trump details Iran nuclear terms, says Iran will never build a weapon
headlines.summary: The Economist reports Trump's MOU with Iran guarantees Tehran will never develop a nuclear weapon, though key implementation details remain unclear. The deal's impact on oil markets and regional security is still unfolding.

headlines.headline: Russian Warship Fires Warning Shots at Yacht in the English Channel
headlines.summary: A Russian frigate fired warning shots at a yacht that came near it while transiting the English Channel, escalating tensions in European waters just days after the UK seized a Russian-linked tanker.

perspectives.angle: Russian warship fires warning shots at UK-registered yacht in English Channel
perspectives.summary: A Russian Navy vessel fired warning shots at a British civilian yacht in the English Channel, with Russia confirming the incident and the UK Ministry of Defence investigating. The escalation marks a rare direct confrontation between Russian military forces and a British civilian vessel in shared waters.

headlines.headline: US Using Iranian Smuggling Tactics to Sneak Oil Out of the Gulf
headlines.summary: Reuters reports the United States has adopted Iranian-style ship-to-ship transfer tactics to bypass the Hormuz blockade and move crude oil out of the Persian Gulf during the conflict, highlighting how the standoff disrupted global energy logistics.

perspectives.angle: US Military Adopts Iranian Smuggling Tactic to Move Oil Through Hormuz
perspectives.summary: The US military has been running covert ship-to-ship oil transfers near the Strait of Hormuz since May, using aerial and water drones plus helicopters to guide convoys to awaiting tankers — adopting tactics Iran pioneered for sanctions evasion.

headlines.headline: B-52 Bomber Crashes at Edwards Air Force Base, All 8 Crew Killed
headlines.summary: A US Air Force B-52 Stratofortress crashed during a test flight at Edwards AFB in California, killing all eight aboard including two Boeing employees. The aircraft burst into flames after takeoff during a radar modernization test mission.

perspectives.angle: US Air Force B-52 bomber crashes at Edwards AFB, all 8 crew killed
perspectives.summary: A B-52 Stratofortress crashed shortly after takeoff at Edwards Air Force Base in California, bursting into flames and killing all eight crew members aboard, including two Boeing employees.

headlines.headline: War-weary Russia is fracturing as domestic dissent grows, analysis warns
headlines.summary: An opinion analysis in The Hill argues that mounting internal pressures — from war fatigue to economic strain — are pushing Russia toward a breaking point, with unpredictable consequences for the Ukraine conflict.

headlines.headline: Zelensky seeks US license to produce anti-ballistic missiles domestically
headlines.summary: President Zelensky said Ukraine is requesting US approval to manufacture anti-ballistic missile systems on Ukrainian soil, a significant shift that would bolster air defense capabilities against Russian strikes.

headlines.headline: WWII Death Railway station built by Allied POWs resurfaces in Thailand after 40 years
headlines.summary: A long-lost railway station along Thailand's infamous Death Railway, constructed by Allied prisoners of war under Japanese captivity, has re-emerged after four decades underwater due to changing water levels.

headlines.headline: Lukashenko Says Russia and Ukraine Must Compromise to End War
headlines.summary: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko, one of Putin's closest allies, said both sides in the Russia-Ukraine war must compromise, calling the conflict now in its fifth year with no end in sight.

perspectives.angle: Lukashenko urges both sides to compromise to end Russia-Ukraine war
perspectives.summary: Belarusian President Lukashenko, one of Putin's closest allies, publicly called for compromise from both Russia and Ukraine to end the war, a notable shift in rhetoric from a key Kremlin ally.

headlines.headline: Iran World Cup team ordered out of US after opening match
headlines.summary: Iran's coach says the team was ordered to leave the United States and return to its training base in Mexico after a 2-2 draw with New Zealand, highlighting how geopolitical tensions are spilling into the World Cup.

headlines.headline: Iran says final nuclear deal talks with US to begin this week
headlines.summary: Iran announced that negotiations on a comprehensive nuclear agreement and sanctions relief with the United States would likely begin later this week, following the memorandum of understanding signed to end the war.

perspectives.angle: JD Vance admits unresolved issues remain in Iran peace deal ahead of G7 talks
perspectives.summary: Vice President JD Vance acknowledged that several issues still remain in the US-Iran peace agreement as G7 leaders prepare to discuss the Middle East, tempering expectations for a finalized deal at the summit.

headlines.headline: Energy firms brace for new era despite Hormuz reopening deal
headlines.summary: Oil and gas majors expect a quick reopening of the Strait of Hormuz but warn that a full return to normal for the Gulf energy industry is unlikely after more than three months of disrupted shipping.

headlines.headline: Canada announces new Russia sanctions after Carney-Zelensky G7 meeting
headlines.summary: Canada unveiled a new sanctions package targeting 162 individuals, entities, and vessels linked to Russia’s shadow fleet and energy sector following a meeting between PM Carney and Zelensky at the G7 summit.

headlines.headline: Ukraine to create new drone units to bolster northern border defenses
headlines.summary: Commander-in-chief Syrskyi announced Ukraine will form new drone units to strengthen defenses along the northern border with Russia and Belarus amid ongoing security concerns.

headlines.headline: FBI disrupts planned attacks targeting White House UFC event, multiple arrests made
headlines.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel announced that law enforcement disrupted planned attacks targeting the UFC Freedom 250 event at the White House, with at least five people arrested in connection with an alleged drone-explosive plot.

perspectives.angle: FBI foils drone and sniper plot targeting White House UFC event, five arrested
perspectives.summary: The FBI arrested five people in connection with an explosive drone and sniper attack planned against the UFC Freedom 250 event on the White House South Lawn, in what officials described as a major security breach.

headlines.headline: US-Iran deal promises end to war but implementation remains unclear
headlines.summary: Doubts swirled around the US-Iran agreement as questions persist about enforcement mechanisms, with shipping traffic and energy exports expected to take weeks to recover through the Strait of Hormuz.

perspectives.angle: US and Iran sign MOU to end war, formal signing ceremony set for Friday
perspectives.summary: Senior US officials confirmed the memorandum of understanding has been signed electronically, with a formal ceremony planned for Friday. Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz will gradually ramp up as mines are cleared.

headlines.headline: Trump hints at renewed Ukraine focus, says Iran moving to rear-view mirror
headlines.summary: After a very good meeting with Zelenskyy at the G7, Trump said Russia should make a deal and suggested Ukraine was moving back up his priority list as the Iran conflict recedes.

headlines.headline: France and Britain push multinational Hormuz naval mission as ceasefire nears
headlines.summary: France and Britain are advancing plans for a coalition naval mission to safeguard Strait of Hormuz shipping if the US-Iran ceasefire holds, though Irans willingness to accept such an operation remains uncertain.

perspectives.angle: France-UK Coalition Ready to Deploy Hormuz Security Mission After Ceasefire
perspectives.summary: A Franco-British naval coalition of roughly 20 countries is prepared to deploy to the Strait of Hormuz to restart commercial shipping. France has committed its nuclear-powered carrier Charles de Gaulle as the flagship amid expectations that traffic will resume Friday under the peace deal.

headlines.headline: Macron and Zelenskyy caught on camera game-planning how to handle Trump at G7
headlines.summary: Footage captured the French president and Ukrainian leader strategizing together before meeting Trump at the G7 summit, highlighting European concerns about Trumps shifting priorities after the Iran deal.

perspectives.angle: Macron and Zelenskyy caught on camera game-planning how to handle Trump at G7
perspectives.summary: Footage captured the French president and Ukrainian leader strategizing together before meeting Trump at the G7 summit, highlighting European concerns about Trumps shifting priorities after the Iran deal.

headlines.headline: Oil spot premiums fall to pre-war levels after US-Iran deal, shipping caution remains
headlines.summary: Asian crude spot premiums have dropped back to levels seen before the US-Iran war following the tentative ceasefire deal, though uncertainty about how quickly normal Hormuz shipping can resume is keeping a floor under prices.

perspectives.angle: Oil spot premiums fall to pre-war levels after US-Iran deal, shipping caution remains
perspectives.summary: Asian crude spot premiums have dropped back to levels seen before the US-Iran war following the tentative ceasefire deal, though uncertainty about how quickly normal Hormuz shipping can resume is keeping a floor under prices.

perspectives.angle: Oil rebounds on concerns about Iran deal details and Hormuz reopening delay
perspectives.summary: Oil prices rebounded on concerns that the preliminary US-Iran peace agreement lacks detail and that resuming supply through the Strait of Hormuz could take longer than expected due to mine-clearance operations.

headlines.headline: Hormuz mine-clearing could delay full shipping return by 40–50 days
headlines.summary: Demining operations involving conventional minesweepers and underwater drones may take 40–50 days before insurers and shipping companies feel confident enough to resume normal traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.headline: France to try 14 over Channel disaster that left 27 Iraqi Kurdish migrants dead
headlines.summary: Fourteen people face trial in France over the deaths of at least 27 migrants in the November 2021 English Channel sinking — the deadliest recorded crossing disaster — in a case that could reshape people-smuggling prosecution across Europe.

headlines.headline: Red Cross warns Congo Ebola epidemic yet to peak, may last a year
headlines.summary: A Red Cross official warned that the Ebola epidemic in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has not yet peaked and could persist for a year, deepening the humanitarian crisis in the conflict-ridden region.

headlines.headline: Trump warns Netanyahu to be 'more responsible' as US-Israel rift deepens over Iran deal
headlines.summary: President Trump publicly rebuked Netanyahu, saying Israel must act more responsibly regarding Lebanon and Hezbollah, as the US-Israel rift over the Iran agreement widens and Iran demands Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon.

perspectives.angle: Congress reacts with skepticism to Trump-Iran deal, demands briefing on secret terms
perspectives.summary: Republican and Democratic senators alike expressed deep skepticism about the US-Iran agreement, with GOP hawks calling it a surrender and Democrats demanding immediate classified briefings on the deal’s undisclosed terms.

headlines.headline: New Fed Chair Warsh faces hawkish shift as first meeting looms
headlines.summary: Kevin Warsh convenes his first Federal Reserve meeting with rate hike expectations rising and the dot plot expected to show a hawkish shift, just weeks after replacing Jerome Powell.

headlines.headline: Japan PM Takaichi pushes coordinated G7 response to China trade tactics
headlines.summary: At the G7 summit, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urged allies to develop a united front against Beijing's use of export controls and trade leverage, signaling rising concern over China Shock 2.0.

headlines.headline: Zelensky, Trump, Macron Hold Behind-the-Scenes Meeting at G7 Summit
headlines.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky met face-to-face with Trump and Macron on the sidelines of the G7 summit in Evian, their first encounter in nearly four months, as Kyiv pushes to revive peace negotiations.

headlines.headline: US Military Plans Permanent War-Ready Weapons Stockpile in Australia
headlines.summary: The US military is planning a permanent war-ready weapons stockpile for its Marine Corps on Australias southeast coast, positioned beyond the range of most Chinese missiles, according to tender documents and officials.

headlines.headline: Japan Undecided on Sending Military Forces to Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary: Japan said Tuesday it has not yet decided whether its military will join international efforts to help resume shipping through the Strait of Hormuz following the US-Iran ceasefire agreement.

perspectives.angle: Macron Tells Trump European Forces Ready to Deploy in Strait of Hormuz
perspectives.summary: At the G7 summit opening in Evian-les-Bains, French President Macron told Trump that European naval forces are prepared to help secure the Strait of Hormuz once the US-Iran deal is signed.

headlines.headline: Lukashenko Says Belarus Poses No Military Threat to Ukraine, Apologizes to Zelensky
headlines.summary: Belarusian leader Alexander Lukashenko stated Belarus poses no military threat to Ukraine and apologized to President Zelensky for previous harsh remarks, a notable diplomatic signal as G7 leaders discuss pathways to ending the Russia-Ukraine war.

headlines.headline: Iran soccer team blocked from training in US, welcomed by Tijuana amid World Cup
headlines.summary: Iran's World Cup squad was denied entry to train in the United States amid the recent conflict, but the Mexican border city of Tijuana rolled out a welcome for the team caught between sport and geopolitics.

headlines.headline: Netanyahu and Trump on Collision Course as US-Iran Deal Falls Short of Israeli War Goals
headlines.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed back against the US-Iran peace agreement, declaring that "the struggle has not ended." The deal falls short of Israel's stated war objectives, creating a rift between the two allies at a critical moment.

perspectives.angle: Trump lashes out at Netanyahu, says Israel hindering Iran peace efforts
perspectives.summary: Donald Trump unleashed a new tirade against Benjamin Netanyahu, claiming Israel is obstructing peace efforts with Iran and repeating that there would be no Israel without him, testing their political alliance.

perspectives.angle: Trump criticizes Netanyahu over Lebanon attacks at G7, warns Israel to be more responsible
perspectives.summary: At the G7 summit, Trump publicly criticized Israeli PM Netanyahu for escalating attacks on Lebanon and Hezbollah, saying Israel must act more responsibly — a rare rift between the two leaders on full display before other world leaders.

headlines.headline: Ukraine drives rush for mini drone laser-targeting systems as battlefield demand surges
headlines.summary: Defense companies are racing to miniaturize laser target-marking technology for small UAVs after Ukraine requested compact systems suited to its drone-heavy battlefield tactics, spurring new product launches across the industry.

headlines.headline: China develops military stealth coating that could be mass-produced as cheap house paint
headlines.summary: Chinese researchers have created a new microwave-absorbing material that could make stealth technology far cheaper to produce, sparking debate over reports that commercial stealth paint may already be available on the open market.

headlines.headline: Central banks accelerate gold buying as de-dollarization trend deepens worldwide
headlines.summary: The World Gold Council reports that nearly 90% of central banks plan to increase gold holdings as countries diversify reserves away from the US dollar, reflecting a structural shift in global finance amid geopolitical fragmentation.

headlines.headline: Surging Chinese exports threaten European economy, raising alarm at G7 summit
headlines.summary: Eight years of US tariffs have failed to dent China industrial output, and a new wave of cheap exports is now pressuring European manufacturers, forcing G7 leaders to confront an escalating trade crisis.

headlines.headline: Norway Crown Princess son convicted of rape, sentenced to four years
headlines.summary: Marius Borg Høiby, eldest son of Norway Crown Princess Mette-Marit, was found guilty of two counts of rape and sentenced to four years in prison in a case that has shaken the Norwegian royal family.

headlines.headline: Takaichi pushes mineral stockpiling plan at G7, seeks to bridge divides as Japan’s Iron Lady takes the stage
headlines.summary: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi proposed a joint critical minerals stockpiling initiative at the G7 summit to counter China’s dominance, while also welcoming the US-Iran memorandum as a step toward regional de-escalation.

perspectives.angle: Japan PM Takaichi proposes G7 framework for stockpiling critical minerals
perspectives.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pitched a plan at the G7 summit for coordinating critical mineral stockpiles among member nations and like-minded countries, aiming to reduce dependency on China for materials vital to defense and green energy industries.

headlines.headline: South Korea and Indonesia rein in derivatives trading to defend currencies amid energy shock
headlines.summary: Asian economies heavily reliant on imported energy are tightening oversight of speculative currency derivatives trades as the Iran war-driven oil disruption rattles forex markets.

headlines.headline: G7 leaders convene in France awaiting clarity on US-Iran agreement terms
headlines.summary: World leaders gathered at the G7 summit in Evian-les-Bains are seeking details on the US-Iran deal, with the Iran war and its implications dominating the agenda alongside trade disputes and the Ukraine conflict.

headlines.headline: Ebola risk for World Cup is extremely low, but US hospitals are ready, experts say
headlines.summary: US infectious disease experts say the risk of an Ebola case arriving during the 2026 World Cup is low but not zero, and American hospitals are prepared to respond if needed amid Congo's ongoing outbreak.

perspectives.angle: Ebola Risk for World Cup Extremely Low but US Hospitals Ready, Experts Say
perspectives.summary: US infectious disease experts say the risk of an Ebola case arriving during the 2026 World Cup is low but not zero, and American hospitals are prepared to respond if needed.

headlines.headline: China embraces Myanmar president as former junta chief seeks legitimacy
headlines.summary: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing's state visit to China gives the former junta chief a significant diplomatic boost as he seeks to consolidate power following a widely condemned election. Xi Jinping hosted the five-day visit in Beijing.

perspectives.angle: Myanmar’s Min Aung Hlaing makes first visit to China as civilian president
perspectives.summary: Myanmar’s former junta chief Min Aung Hlaing arrived in Beijing for a five-day visit at Xi Jinping’s invitation, his first trip to China since being elected president — a sign of deepening ties between the two authoritarian governments.

headlines.headline: Iran's US diaspora divided between protest and cheering at World Cup
headlines.summary: Iranian Americans are torn over Iran's participation in the 2026 World Cup, with some planning to watch the game and others protesting outside the LA stadium where the team played its opening match amid the backdrop of the US-Iran war.

headlines.headline: How the US-Israel war with Iran unfolded over 108 turbulent days
headlines.summary: A comprehensive timeline of the key moments in the 108-day US-Israel war with Iran that claimed thousands of lives and fundamentally reshaped the Middle East security landscape, from the first strikes to the tentative peace deal.

headlines.headline: G7 leaders to meet Zelensky as Trump signals possible Ukraine breakthrough
headlines.summary: G7 leaders will hold talks with President Zelensky on Tuesday as Trump suggested a possible breakthrough on Ukraine peace, shifting focus from the Iran deal to the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict at the summit in France.

headlines.headline: Social media overtakes traditional outlets as worlds leading news source for first time
headlines.summary: News consumers worldwide are increasingly turning to social media and video platforms for information, overtaking traditional outlets for the first time according to a Reuters Institute report, raising concerns about misinformation and media sustainability.

headlines.headline: Russia slashes fuel quality rules as Ukrainian attacks squeeze domestic supplies
